overal.goal: Fix the three regressions the phase 3 re-review left open: (1) the selected and focused row on the Tasks page has no visible outline because `outline-none` sits beside `outline-2` in packages/web/ui/src/tasks/TaskRow.tsx — remove it so the selection is visible; (2) the task detail's Injected list goes stale because appendInjected/markInjectedApplied do not change the useTask refetch key — add the injected section's length (or applied count) to the key built in src/task/TaskDetailPage.tsx; (3) the notice when a run starts while the form is dirty only appears when the prompt changed — show 'The task started running, so your unsaved edits were not saved.' for any dirty edit, and the 'Copy unsaved prompt' button only when the prompt differed (src/task/TaskForm.tsx).
overal.stack: TypeScript monorepo (Node 22 / Bun), Hono server, React + Vite UI (shadcn/ui on Tailwind v4), vitest

rules.do: Read README.md, docs/boof-runner.md and docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-27-ui-redesign-design.md before changing code.
Write a failing test first where the change is logic (src/lib, server); keep the change focused on this goal.
Run `npm run typecheck && npx prettier --check . && npx vitest run && npm run build:server` before finishing.
rules.dont: Do not change public API or MCP shapes without updating docs and the OpenAPI document.
Do not commit secrets, data roots or build output.

versions.version: Carried over from the UI redesign (phase 3 final review, 2026-10-29); not started.

tests.strategy: Screenshots light, dark, 420 px and desktop of every changed screen, checked against the spec's Global Constraints; unit tests for any src/lib logic.
